Committee: Banking and Insurance
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 69 as introduced exempts flood insurance from rate filings and approval of those rates before use. This bill would expand the market for flood insurance in Alabama and could increase receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of policies written. This bill would also increase the obligations of the Department of Insurance by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional filings that require analysis and review.
Shay Shelnutt, Chairperson
Banking and Insurance

Committee: Insurance
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 69 as passed the Senate exempts flood insurance from rate filings and approval of those rates before use.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Kerry Rich, Chair
Insurance

Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Hall
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/16/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 385 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the expenditures of local boards of education and the State Department of Education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to implement the changes to sex education curriculum required by this bill.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy
